title: Sleeper card
description: The JSON a Sleeper job seals as the sleeper.cards artifact (the workspace file cards.json). Exactly one job's card; the kind names which one, and the page and the job's eval adapter read it by that field. The contract describes cards sealed from this version on: validate() runs only at seal time, so older stored cards are never re-validated, and readers keep tolerating what their writer omitted (the page already reads (s.cited ?? []) for history seasons).

examples.summary: Start Lamar Jackson over Drake Maye at QB.

starters.why: Top fantasy ADP and his game is still open.

news.title: Lamar Jackson named the Ravens' starter
news.excerpt: ...the Ravens said Lamar Jackson is the starter Sunday...

lineup.description: Lineup card: the starters and bench for the current week.

kind.description: Discriminator; this card is the lineup job's.

league.description: The Sleeper league id the card is about.

week.description: The Sleeper week the card is about.

opponent.description: The opponent's roster display name; null when the team has no game that week.

my_proj.description: Projected points of the starters shown, summed by code and rounded to two decimals.

opp_proj.description: Projected points of the opponent's Sleeper lineup; null when there is no opponent.

summary.description: The code's reading of the card: one 'Start X over Y' line per change, or the no-changes line. Written by code from the rows, never by the model.

starters.description: One row per slot, in slot order, each with the player in the slot and why he is there.

slot.description: The slot name, e.g. QB, RB1.

proj.description: The player's projection for the week, from the facts.

action.description: What the model did to this slot: 'start' changed the starter, 'keep' left the incumbent in.

locked.description: True when the slot's game has already started, so the player is locked in by construction.

replaces.description: The incumbent the starter moved over; null when the slot is unchanged or was empty.

game.description: The player's game this week; null when he has none.

why.description: The model's one-line reason for this slot.

news.description: News the code attached for the starter and, on a change, the replaced player, so a link is never the model's to copy.

bench.description: The roster players not started, best projection first; injury-reserve, taxi and empty-slot players are excluded by the facts.

proj.description: The player's projection for the week, from the facts.

game.description: The player's game this week; null when he has none.

waivers.description: Waivers card: the week's claims and the players checked and passed.

kind.description: Discriminator; this card is the waivers job's.

league.description: The Sleeper league id the card is about.

week.description: The Sleeper week the card is about.

waiver_type.description: The league's waiver type, as the code reads it from the league settings: rolling or reverse_standings is a queue, faab is bidding.

my_priority.description: The team's position in the waiver queue; null when Sleeper sends no waiver_position.

faab_left.description: The FAAB bids left in the league — the budget minus the bids used, before this card's bid; null in a non-faab league, where the queue is the currency.

teams.description: The number of teams in the league.

summary.description: The model's summary of the week's wire; the code substitutes the no-claims line only when the model listed no candidates and its text does not already say 'no claim'.

candidates.description: The model's claims in its order, ranked from 1.

rank.description: The claim's rank, 1-based, in the model's order.

player.description: The free agent the claim adds.

proj.description: The player's projection for the week, from the facts.

owned_pct.description: Sleeper's platform-wide ownership percent for the player — the share of all Sleeper leagues that own him, not just the teams in this league; null when the data has none.

adds_24h.description: The player's added-ownership count over the last 24 hours; present only when the data provides a count.

bye.description: The NFL week the player's team is on bye; null when there is none.

drop.description: The roster player the claim drops.

player.description: The roster player the claim drops.

role.description: The drop's role on the roster: a starter, a bench player, or an injury-reserve player.

size.description: How much the claim costs, in the league's own currency.

oneOf.description: A faab bid, with the budget left and its share of it.

kind.description: Discriminator for the size: a faab bid.

bid.description: The bid the model made, whole bids.

left.description: The FAAB bids left in the league before the bid; the percentage is the bid over this number.

pct.description: The bid's whole-number share of the FAAB left, 0-100.

oneOf.description: The queue position the claim spends.

kind.description: Discriminator for the size: the priority queue position.

position.description: The team's queue position; null when the league has no queue position for the team.

of.description: The number of teams the position is out of.

why.description: The model's one-line reason for the claim.

news.description: News the code attached for the add and the drop, so a link is never the model's to copy.

also_checked.description: Free agents the model looked at and passed, each with its reason.

player.description: The free agent the model passed on.

why.description: The model's one-line reason to pass.

digest.description: Digest card: the league's games for the week, in preview or recap.

kind.description: Discriminator; this card is the digest job's.

league.description: The Sleeper league id the card is about.

week.description: The Sleeper week the card is about.

past.description: True when the week has been played (a recap of final scores); false for a preview before the week.

summary.description: The model's story for the week.

games.description: One row per matchup; the lower roster id is listed first, since Sleeper has no home side.

home.description: The first side of the matchup; Sleeper has no home side, so the lower roster id is listed first.

away.description: The second side of the matchup.

margin.description: The absolute point gap between the two sides, rounded to two decimals.

mine.description: True when the user's roster is one of the sides.

note.description: The model's one-line note for the game; the empty string when it wrote none.

news.description: News the code attached for the game's top scorers and designated starters, so a link is never the model's to copy.

playoff_line.description: The playoff race as the card was written.

remaining_weeks.description: The weeks left in the season.

source_note.description: The code's note on where the points come from: final scores in a recap, and the averaging rule in a preview.

retro.description: Retro card: the week looked back on — the best lineup, the missed swaps, and the misses knowable before kickoff.

kind.description: Discriminator; this card is the retro job's.

league.description: The Sleeper league id the card is about.

week.description: The Sleeper week the card is about.

opponent.description: The opponent's roster display name; null on a bye.

bye.description: True on a bye week, when the matchup has no opponent.

started.description: The points the started lineup scored, rounded to two decimals.

opp.description: The opponent's points; null on a bye.

won.description: Whether the team won the week's matchup; false on a bye.

best.description: The best legal lineup's points for the week, from the facts.

left.description: The points the best lineup left over the started one: best minus started.

misses.description: Best-lineup players who did not start, each paired with the lowest-scoring legal starter he could have replaced.

slot.description: The slot the replacement would have played.

started.description: The starter who was in the slot.

better.description: The bench player who should have started instead.

swing.description: The points gained by the swap: better minus started.

knowable.description: True only when the model cited a link the code attached that is dated before the row's cutoff.

signal.description: The pre-kickoff signal that made the miss knowable; null when none was found.

before.description: The ISO 8601 instant a signal must have preceded: the earlier of the two players' kickoffs.

why.description: The model's one-line reading of the miss; the code's no-signal line when it wrote none.

waiver_misses.description: Free agents who outscored a legal starter, judged against the last waiver run before kickoff.

pts.description: The free agent's points for the week.

over_name.description: The starter he would have replaced.

over_pts.description: That starter's points for the week.

knowable.description: True only when the model cited a link the code attached that is dated before the row's cutoff.

signal.description: The pre-waiver-run signal that made the miss knowable; null when none was found.

before.description: The ISO 8601 instant the last waiver run before the week's kickoff: a signal must have preceded it.

why.description: The model's one-line reading of the miss; the code's no-signal line when it wrote none.

lessons.description: The model's process fixes, at most three: the model's decision schema caps the array at three and the builder keeps the first three it was given.

summary.description: The model's summary of the week.

trade-finder.description: Trade-finder card: the deals worth asking about this week.

kind.description: Discriminator; this card is the trade-finder job's.

league.description: The Sleeper league id the card is about.

week.description: The Sleeper week the card is about.

summary.description: The model's summary of the deals; the code substitutes the no-deals line only when the model listed no suggestions and its text does not already say 'no deal'.

suggestions.description: The model's deals in its order, ranked from 1; at most three, one player each way, each taking one of the partner's surplus players — the builder throws on a fourth.

rank.description: The deal's rank, 1-based, in the model's order.

partner.description: The other team in the deal.

stance.description: The partner's standing as the code computes it: in the playoff line is a contender, below it a rebuilder.

needs.description: The partner's need by position, from the facts; one number per position it wants.

partner_need.description: The model's line on what the deal does for the partner.

give.description: The user's player in the deal, with his projection.

get.description: The partner's surplus player in the deal, with his projection.

delta.description: The projection swing this week, per side: what each receives minus what each sends.

note.description: The model's one-line note for the deal.

news.description: News the code attached for both players in the deal, so a link is never the model's to copy.

trends.description: Trends card: the league's movements since the previous snapshot.

kind.description: Discriminator; this card is the trends job's.

league.description: The Sleeper league id the card is about.

week.description: The Sleeper week the card is about.

date.description: The snapshot day this run reads, YYYY-MM-DD.

since.description: The previous snapshot day diffed against, YYYY-MM-DD; null on the first snapshot, which has nothing to compare with.

summary.description: The code's count of the items, or the first-snapshot line when there is no since.

source_note.description: The model's note on its sources.

trendItem.description: One movement in the league: an injury or depth change, a waiver riser, dated news, or the model's note.

time.description: When it happened, 'YYYY-MM-DD (Day)' in the league's clock.

source.description: Who reported it: 'Sleeper' for a field the snapshot diffed, otherwise the outlet the model named.

player.description: The player the item is about; present only when the item names one.

pos.description: The player's position; null when the data has none.

team.description: The player's team; null when he is a free agent.

inj.description: The player's injury designation; null when the data has none.

text.description: The item's one sentence; the model's decision schema caps it at 160 characters so one sentence stays one line — the builder does not re-check it.

link.description: The news item the model linked for the player; present only when the item is a link, never a url the model invented.

history.description: History card: the team's seasons, newest first, with the model's net-position read per season.

kind.description: Discriminator; this card is the history job's.

league.description: The Sleeper league id the card is about.

week.description: The Sleeper week the card is about.

definitions.description: The definitions behind the figures, declared once on the card so the reader and the judge share the one rule.

reach_steal.description: When a draft pick counts as a reach or a steal, in position-rank gap.

efficiency.description: How the season efficiency figure is computed.

close_loss.description: What counts as a close loss.

left.description: How the points-left-on-the-bench figure is computed per week.

seasons.description: The team's seasons, newest first, each with its figures and the model's read.

summary.description: The model's summary of the team's seasons.

season.description: One season's figures, plus the model's note and the draft rows it discusses.

league_id.description: The Sleeper league id for that season; older seasons are earlier leagues in the chain.

in_progress.description: True while the season is being played.

pf.description: Points for, rounded to two decimals.

pa.description: Points against, rounded to two decimals.

pf_rank.description: The roster's rank by points for, 1 best: the most points for.

pa_rank.description: The roster's rank by points against, 1 best: the fewest against.

eff.description: Season points scored over the best possible points, as a percentage; null when Sleeper reports no best possible.

left_total.description: The season's total points left on the bench, week over week.

close_losses.description: The number of close losses, per the card's close_loss definition.

champion.description: The season champion's roster display name; null when there is no finished bracket to name one.

weeks.description: The regular season's weeks, in order; a week without a matchup is absent.

result.description: The week's result against the opponent; null when the team was on bye.

started.description: The started lineup's points for the week.

best.description: The best legal lineup's points for the week.

left.description: The points the best lineup left over the started one.

opp.description: The opponent's points; null on a bye.

close_loss.description: Whether the week was a loss inside the close-loss margin.

draft.description: The team's draft picks, graded; null while the season is in progress, when there is no finish to grade against.

note.description: The model's read of the season; null when it wrote none.

cited.description: The draft rows the note discusses, in pick order; empty when it cites none. Readers keep the (s.cited ?? []) fallback, because history cards sealed before this contract lack cited.

draftFigure.description: One draft pick, graded against its finish within its position.

pick.description: The pick number in the draft.

drafted_as.description: The pick's rank when drafted, by pick number within its position; 0 when unranked.

finished.description: The pick's rank when the season finished, by full-season points within its position; 0 when unranked.

pts.description: The player's full-season points under the league's scoring.

verdict.description: The pick's grade against the card's reach_steal definition; unknown when it cannot be graded.

digestSide.description: One side of a matchup on the digest card.

pts.description: The side's points for the week: the final score in a recap, the starters' recent-week average in a preview.

top_scorers.description: The side's top scorers for the week, best first.

pts.description: The scorer's points for the week.

standing.description: One roster in the league standings.

rank.description: The roster's rank in the standings, 1 best.

in_playoff_line.description: Whether the roster sits in the playoff line.

playerRef.description: A player as the card names him.

pos.description: The player's position, as Sleeper writes it.

team.description: The player's team; null when he is a free agent.

inj.description: The player's injury designation; null when the data has none.

playerNews.description: A news item with the player it is about, attached by code so a link is never the model's to copy.

title.description: The item's headline, or its url when the source gave none.

url.description: The item's link, from the facts the job searched.

date.description: The publication date the search source reported; the empty string when the source gave none.

excerpt.description: A window of the source text around the player's name; absent when the title names the player.

player.description: The player the item is about.

playerNewsList.description: News the job's code attached for the card's players, so a link is never the model's to copy.

game.description: A player's game for the week, from the schedule.

opponent.description: The opponent NFL team, as the schedule writes it.

home.description: Whether the player's team is at home.

kickoff.description: The kickoff instant, ISO 8601; null when it is not set.

locked.description: Whether the game has locked, so the starter in it cannot change.

status.description: The game's status, as the schedule reports it; null when it reports none.

namePts.description: A player on the retro card, by name and points for the week.

pts.description: The player's points for the week.

tRef.description: A player on a trade, with his projection for the week.

pos.description: The player's position, as Sleeper writes it.

team.description: The player's team; null when he is a free agent.

inj.description: The player's injury designation; null when the data has none.

proj.description: The player's projection for the week, from the facts.

bye.description: The NFL week the player's team is on bye; null when there is none.
